answer: To blunt sybil swarms, every agent posts a bonded work-trail that acts as a public lantern: each outbound transfer must cite prior signed telemetry hashes. Admission into a settlement grove requires two existing members to co-sign that trail. If a whisper of colliding keys or recycled fingerprints appears, the grove slashes the bond and isolates the cluster, so cheap clones cannot outvote operators who paid for unique history.
